status_note: ADNOC Ruwais is INSIDE Hormuz. Strait of Hormuz effectively closed/restricted (28-29 Oct 2026: ~2-7% of normal traffic, mine strikes on tankers, Iran demands transit permits). Sulphur exits Gulf at ~55% of pre-war pace (Kpler, 26 Oct); Maersk suspended Gulf bookings; only ~2 containerships/week entering Gulf (Drewry wk 42). Majority of Gulf sulphur that does exit comes from Ruwais (Kpler). Containers possible via Khor Fakkan/Fujairah (outside strait) by truck; attacks reported near Sohar/Bukha 21 Oct.
